tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zhu ba'i 'phrin yig bzhugs so// ༄༅// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zhu ba'i 'phrin yig bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// brtse ba dang ldan gzhan la phan dgongs shes bya kun la sgrib pa dang bral ye shes mnga'// mkha' ltar rnam dag nye bar zhi la lhun gyi grub pas dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i phrin las can// gang zhig rtag tu phongs pa kun skyob 'jig rten spyod pa dag las rnam grol ba// gsol ba btab na bslu ba med ldan rgyal dang de sras rnams la 'phrin 'di zhu// bde byed tshangs dbang lhar bcas 'jig rten gyis// gang gi snyan pa sa gsum rab bsgrags pa// 'gro ba'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa yi// zhabs pad dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo// swa sti thugs rje'i spyan ldan pa// thams cad gzigs pa'i ye shes can// 'jig rten mngon sum gzigs pa la// mgon po bdag ni zhu bar 'tshal// khyed kyis dang por byang chub thugs// gzhan gyi don slad kho nar bskyed// de rjes brtson pas grangs med gsum// lus dang srog la ltos med bsgrubs// de nas byang chub snying por khyod// byang chub dam pa brnyes mdzad de// rnam grol chos kyi 'khor lo ni// rmad byung dam pa rab bskor nas// de nas khyod kyis dam pa'i chos// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun bsdus te// nga ni mya ngan 'das gyur nas// chos 'di khyod kyis ston pa yin// des na tshig don ma nyams par// nga yi bstan pa zung shig ces// sras kyi mchog la gtad mdzad de// lnga brgya tha ma'i bstan pa yang*// sde snod 'dzin pa rnams la gtad// de yi bsgrub pa'i bya ba kun// lhar bcas 'jig rten gtso bo dang*// sbyin bdag stobs can thams cad la// nan tan gyis ni legs gtad nas// mgon po mya ngan 'da' tshul bstan// de rjes 'phags pa'i gang zag dang*// so so skye bo mkhas pa dang*// chos rgyal rnams dang sbyin bdag ni// stobs ldan dad pa can rnams kyis// bstan pa yun ring gus pas bskyangs// deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'di na// thub pa'i bstan pa phal cher nub// chos mngon mdzod las gsungs pa ltar// ngan rtog rnams kyis bstan pa dkrugs// khyad par du yang byang phyogs kyi// kha ba can gyi bstan pa 'di// ngan rtog mun pas rnam par khyab// dge sbyong phal cher thos pa nyung*// thos pa de dag brtson pa nyung*// sdom brtson phal cher bkur pa nyung*// bkur pa de dag sdom brtson nyung*// sbyin bdag chos la dad pa nyung*// dad pa can gyi mchod bya dman// mchod pa de dag log 'tsho'i rgyu// gal te log 'tsho mi za ba'i// chos byed de dag dman dman 'dra// sangs rgyas bstan la dad na yang*// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// sangs rgyas gsung rab ngo mtshar can// de dag bzhi mdo'i rtsa'i bzhin dor// blun po rnams kyi brdzun tshig la// thub pa'i bka' bas gus par 'dzin// bdag nyid chen po klu sgrub dang*// thogs med dang ni dbyig gi gnyen// phyogs kyi glang po chos grags sogs// mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung rab dang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa// 'phags pa'i lha sogs grub thob kyi// gsung rab yin par nges pa rnams// dug bzhin 'bad pas spangs nas ni// skyes bu rdzun mas sbyar ba yi// log rtog rnams la cher 'bad nas// grub thob rnams kyi gsung yin zhes// blun po rnams la rgyas par byed// 'jig rten shes rab ldan pa dkon// bsod nams ldan pa shin tu nyung*// de nas dam chos rin po che// khyed kyi gsung rab 'dzin pa dkon// de ltar shes nas shākya yi// bstan pa nub par dogs pa dang*// bdag nyid legs par sbyang phyir dang*// gzhan la phan par bsam nas ni// lung dang rigs pa phal cher sbyangs// de yi stobs kyis chos kyi gnad// 'khrul pa dang ni ma 'khrul ba'i// rnam gzhag cung zad bdag gis go

/'di la rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras// mkhas pa sde snod 'dzin pa dang*// grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu mchog /mngon sum gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa// de dag kun ni dpang po lags// des na bdag gi 'thad mi 'thad// re zhig gsan par mdzad du gsol// khyed kyi gsung las 'di skad 'byung*// dge slong dag gang mkhas rnams kyis// bsregs bcad bdar ba'i gser bzhin du// yongs su brtags la nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// zhes gsungs gzhan yang mdo sde las// bstod 'os smad par mi bya zhing*// smad 'os bstod par mi bya zhes// gsungs pa de yang yid la bzhag /slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas kyis// dad pa med pa gtso bo'i sgra// lhag dad shin tu gol ba'i gnas// gang phyir kun mkhyen tshad mas grub// gus pas kun mkhyen 'gyur ba min// zhes gsungs de yang bden par rtogs// de bzhin sde snod thams cad dang*// bstan bcos chen po thams cad las// 'khrul pa thams cad 'bad pas bkag /ma 'khrul pa rnams sgrub par mthong*// dam pa'i rnam thar bskyang 'dod nas// bdag kyang de yi rjes 'brangs te// chos kyi rnam dbye cung zad byas// de la blo gros ldan pa yi// sde snod 'dzin pa phal cher dga'// thos med blo gros bral ba yi// chags sdang can rnams phal cher smod// bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa la// sangs rgyas thams cad gzigs su gsol// gal te log par smra na ni// khyed rnams kyis kyang bdag la khrel// 'on te bden par smra na ni// khyed kyis bdag la dgyes par mdzod// sgra chad sdeb sbyor snyan ngag dang*// tshig rgyan ming gi nges brjod sogs// shin tu mkhas pa rnams la grags// sde snod gsum po de sbyangs pa'i// sde snod 'dzin pa rnams kyis mkhyen// rgyud sde bzhi po de shes pa'i// rgyud sde 'dzin rnams mkhyen par gsal// de dag min pa'i chos gzhan ni// shākya'i rgyal pos gsungs pa med// de dag rnams kyi man ngag ni// rang rang gzhung dang mthun na yin// mi mthun pa de zab na yang*// sangs rgyas gsung dang ma 'brel phyir// mu stegs byed kyi zab par 'gyur// rnam dbye 'di ltar 'thad mi 'thad// sangs rgyas rnams kyis legs par dgongs// sgra la yi ge ming dang tshig

/ngag dang rab tu dbye ba sogs// chos kyi phung po'i bar du yang*// tshig bzang ba dang don brlings pa// bden pa dang ni snyan pa sogs// yon tan kun ldan thub pa'i gsung*// yi ge la ni ring thung dang*// shin tu ring dang mthug rkyang dang*// drag zhan dang ni lci yang dang*/ u tad a nut+ta ra sogs// bod la grags pa med stobs kyis// phal cher dag pa shin du nyung*// de la bdag gi ring thung sogs// rnam dbye sgra dang mthun par bgyis// de la sgra sbyor mi shes pas// phal cher bdag la 'gal bar 'dzin// sdeb sbyor la ni lci yang dang*// ngal so'i gnas sogs gzhung lugs dang*// legs par bstun nas bkod pa la// sdeb sbyor med rnams the tshom za// tshig gi rgyan dang mngon brjod sogs// mkhas pa'i gzhung dang mthun par byas// de la blun po rgyab kyis phyogs// tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dbye bsdu dang*// mngon sum rjes su dpag pa la// snang ba dang ni sel ba dang*// 'brel ba dang ni 'brel med sogs// sgra dang rtog pa 'jug tshul la// lung dang rigs pa mi 'gal zhing*// chos kyi grags pa'i sde bdun ltar// bdag gis legs par brjod pa la// tshad ma ltar snang smra rnams rgol// khyod kyi 'dul ba'i sde snod la// sdud mdzad phyi mas sde pa bzhi// skad rigs rnam pa bzhi dag gis// 'dul ba lung rnams sde bzhir bsdus// de la sde pa bco brgyad kyis// gnang bkag mi 'dra sna tshogs gsungs// dang por len pa'i cho ga dang*// bar du gsung ba'i gnang bkag dang*// tha mar sdom pa gtong tshul dang*// byin rlabs dang ni phyir bcos pa'i// cho ga'i bye brag thams cad la// sde pa bzhi po mi 'dra ba'i// rnam par dbye ba du ma mthong*// pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags kyi// theg pa'i rim pa'i dbye ba yis// sems can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir// gnang bkag dbye ba du ma snang*// de dag bdag gis lung bzhin bshad// de la lung dang 'gal ba yi// ye bkag ye gnang zhes bya ba// 'dod pa de dag bdag la gshe// don dam zhes bya'i byang chub sems// chos nyid kyis ni thob ces gsungs// cho ga gzhung las bshad pa med// de skad bdag gis bshad pa la// chags sdang yin zhes 'ga' zhig smra// kun rdzob sems bskyed cho ga las// skye phyir brda las 'byung bar gsungs// de la nyan thos theg chen gnyis// nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi la// sems bskyed cho ga tha dad yod// theg chen pa la'ang sems tsam dang*// dbu ma'i sems bskyed rnam gnyis snang*// bdag gis de dag phye ste bshad// de la sde snod mi shes pa'i// skye bo phal cher bdag la rgol// de yi bslab par bya ba'i chos// bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems// lung dang rigs pas bsgrubs pa la// 'jig rten pa dag bzhad gad byed// de yi bslab bya'i chos gzhan yang*// sangs rgyas gsung bzhin bdag gi bsgrubs// 'di la'ang bden par 'dzin pa dka'// deng sang sngags la mos pa mang*// gsang sngags slob pa shin tu nyung*// blo gsal rnams kyis 'bad na yang*// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa shes dka' na// blun po ma bslabs pa rnams kyis// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ga la shes// dang po mkhas pa mi bsten par// phyi nas slob ma sdud pa mthong*// de yi stobs kyis gsang sngags la// nor pa'i rnam gzhag du ma mthong*// bdag gis bshad pa bden mi bden// rgyal ba sras bcas gsan du gsol// gal te gsang sngags mi bsgom na// dbang bskur med kyang 'gal ba med// gsang sngags bsgom la mos gyur na// ci nas dbang bskur dgos par gsungs// phyag rgya chen po thig le las// dbang med na ni dngos grub med// bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin// gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis// dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa// slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag

/dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye// de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// bla ma las ni dbang nod zhu// zhes gsungs rdo rje phreng ba las// dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad pa// de don legs par shes na yang*// slob dpon slob ma mtshungs par ni// shi nas ngu 'bod chen por ltung*// zhes gsungs dam pa dang po las// dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad dang*// sngags kyi de nyid sgom byed pa// de don legs par shes na yang*// dmyal bar 'gyur gyis grol ba min// zhes gsungs de bzhin rgyud gzhan dang*// bstan bcos chen po thams cad las// dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig ldan// de yis gsang sngags bsgom par gsungs// de skad khyed kyis gsungs pa yi// dgongs pa bdag gis bshad pa la// rgyud sde mi shes pa rnams rgol// cung zad shes kyang ma go ba'i// blun po rnams kyang bdag la gshe// de yang blo ldan legs bslabs pa// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob dpon ni// dbang bskur mdzad pa nyung bar snang*// blun po cho ga mi shes pa// de dag rmongs pa'i tshogs bsdus nas// slob ma brgya stong du ma la// sbyor dngos rjes kyi cho ga kun// nyams pa'i dbang bskur byed pa thos// de yi sngags dang ting 'dzin dang*// cho ga'i khyad par thams cad la// khyod kyi gsung dang mthun pa med// de la dngos grub ji ltar mchi// khyed kyis gsang ba spyi rgyud las// khyad par can gyi las rnams la// lha dus bya ba dus bzhin spyad// gzhan du cho ga nyams pa'i phyir// grub pa nam yang yod ma yin// de la sogs pa'i gsung gis ni// cho ga cung zad 'khrul pa la'ang*// dngos grub 'byung bar ma gsungs na// deng sang thams cad 'khrul pa la// dngos grub 'dod pa bdud kyis bslus// de slad bdag gis cho ga kun// dag par bshad la khro ba mang*// kha cig phag mo'i byin rlabs dang*// ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur dang*// gtor ma'i dbang bskur la sogs pa// brdzun mas sbyar ba'i cho ga la// blun po 'jug pa smos ci dgos// sde snod 'dzin par rlom pa yi// snying med rnams kyang 'di la dad// 'di 'dra gal te chos yin na// de las chos min gang zhig lags// mdo rgyud kun las 'di ma gsungs// kha cig gang zag dbang po rab// phag mo'i dbang gis smin zhes zer// gang zag rab 'bring thams cad la// phag mo'i smin byed bshad pa med// gal te yod na khyod nyid dpang*// las chog mgo la bzhag pa yis// dge slong 'gyur zhes zer ba dang*// khyim pas mkhan slob byas pa la// bsnyen rdzogs 'byung zhes zer ba thos// 'di la mkhas rnams bzhad gad byed// phag mo'i dbang bskur la sogs la// deng sang bzhad gad byed pa med// gsung rab tshad mar byed na ni// de 'dra'i rab byung cho ga dang*// 'di 'dra'i dbang bskur bshad pa med// de dag gnyis ka 'khrul pas na// dam pa rnams kyis 'di ma byed// 'di 'dra'i log rtog bkag pa la// chags sdang can rnams bdag la rgol// bdag gis smras pa bden mi bden// sangs rgyas sras bcas gzigs su gsol// gzhan yang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na// rab gnas sbyin sreg gtor ma dang*// ro sreg dang ni bdun tshigs dang*// bar do dang ni 'pho ba dang*// dmigs pa'i bye brag mang po la// da lta'i cho ga byed pa rnams// phal cher khyed kyi gsung dang 'gal// lhag chad nor pa mang po mthong*// de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa la// gnod par bsams nas bdag gis bkag

/de la'ang mdo rgyud la sdang zhing*// bla ma ngan la gus pa yi// blun po phal cher bdag la smod// 'di la'ang bdag tshig bden mi bden// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams dgongs// rgyud sde bzhi po'i lag len yang*// deng sang 'chol par spyod pa mang*// don yod zhags pa la sogs pa'i// cho ga bya ba'i rgyud kyi yin// de la rnal 'byor chen po yi// rim gnyis la sogs sbyor ba mthong*/ de bzhin rgyu sde gzhan la yang*// cho ga 'chol bar byed pa mang*// dgyes rdor bde mchog la sogs pa// dbus kyi gtso bo yul phyung nas// mi yi gzugs brnyan 'jog pa mthong*// sangs rgyas sku la sbyang gzhi dang*// sbyong byed 'phrod pa'i rten 'brel yod// mi yi lus la rten 'brel med// gal te bla ma sangs rgyas nyid// yin nas sangs rgyas sku yis chog /min na sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul// phyung nas mi yi gzugs 'jog pa// sdig pa'i sa bon mi lci 'am// 'di 'dra'i lag len phyin ci log /ma bkag na ni bstan la gnod// bkag na gzhan gyi sems la gzan// gsung rab tshad mar mi byed na// dge slong dang ni dbang bskur la// sogs pa'i cho ga ci zhig dgos// gsung rab tshad mar byed na ni// dbang bskur la sogs cho ga rnams// mdo rgyud bzhin du cis mi byed// 'ga' zhig 'khrul par shes bzhin du// bsnyen bkur 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis// cho ga thams cad 'khrul pa nyid// byed pa bdud kyis bslus pa yin// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa la// nor pa'i rnam gzhag mang po mthong*// de dag bkag la'ang khro ba mang*// 'on kyang khyed nyid dpang po lags// bcom ldan khyod kyis gsang sngags lam// rim pa gnyis su bsdus te gsungs// de la rim gnyis mi dgos zhes// gsang sngags bsgom pa phal cher sgrogs// de dag khyed kyi gsung gis bkag /de la'ang de yi rigs can khro// bskyed rim bsgom pa phal cher yang*// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs 'phrod pa'i// cho ga'i rnam gzhag me shes par// rang bzo'i dkrongs bskyed bsgom pa mthong*// bskyed rim gsal ba rab kyi mthar// son pa'i gang zag yang rab kyis// rdzogs rim gtso bor sbyang ba'i tshe// dkrongs bskyed gsungs kyi da lta min// dper na kha zas dkrongs bskyed la// sngon du 'tshog chas mi dgos sam// sngon du tshogs sbyor ma bsgoms pa'i// bar chad med lam dkrongs bskyed dang*// sa bcu rim gyis ma bgrod par// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin la// snyoms par 'jug pa mi srid bzhin// bskyed pa'i rim pas ma sbyangs pa'i// lha sgom dkrongs bskyed de dang 'dra// cho ga bzhin du sngags bzlas na// gsang sngags rgyal po tshe 'dir 'grub// cho ga med na sngags bzang yang*// zlos par dgos pa chung bar gsungs// rnam dag tshul bzhin shes pa yis// gtum mo ye shes skye ba'i thabs// rnam dag med pa'i gtum mo ni// drod tsam skye yi ye shes min// drod skye ba yi gtum mo ni// mu stegs lugs yin nged kyi min// de bzhin rlung dang 'khrul 'khor sogs// mu stegs byed dang sangs rgyas pa'i// rnam gzhag mtshungs pa 'dra ba yod// gser dang ra gan 'byed pa la// 'dris pa med na phyed pa dka'// phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa yang*// dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang*// rim gnyis ting 'dzin khyad par can// yin zhes khyed kyi gsung las 'byung*// kha cig dkar po chig thub la// phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod byed// shor sa bzhi dang gol sa gsum// spangs la gnyug ma bsgom par bya// bram ze skud pa 'khal ba ltar// so ma ma bcos lhug par gzhag

/'di la phyag rgya chen po zer// 'di don brtags na 'di ltar mthong*// so mar bzhag na bal nyid yin// skud par byas na bcos par 'gyur// de phyir 'di la dpe skyon yod// don gyi skyon yang 'di ltar mthong*// gol sa gsum po bcad tsam gyis// phyag rgya chen por 'gyur na ni// nyan thos 'gog pa'ang der 'gyur ro// shor sa bzhi po spang snyam pa'i// rnam rtog phyag rgya chen po min// rtog pa med na spong mi nus// rtog pa med kyang spong nus na// sems can kun la 'bad med par// phyag rgya chen po cis mi skye// des na phyag rgya chen po nyid// yin na shor sa gol sa med// yod na phyag rgya chen po min// de phyir 'di 'dra'i chos lugs kyi// phyag rgya chen po gsungs pa med// des na rgyud nas ma gsungs pa'i// phyag rgya chen po de mi 'dod// de skad bdag gis bsgrags pa la// rgyud sde mi shes pa rnams khro// khro ba de dang bdag gang bden// rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol// theg pa rim dgu'i rnam gzhag gi /'khrul dang ma 'khrul dpyad pa la// rgyud sde'i rnam dbye mi shes pa'i// skye bo phal cher bdag sun 'byin// 'di yang gang bden gang brdzun pa// 'phags pa rnams kyis dgongs su gsol// kha cig sangs rgyas gsung rab ni// nges don gcig pu kho na yin// dgongs pa dang ni ldem dgongs med// ji bzhin ji bzhin ma yin pa'i// sgra yang gnyis su gsungs pa med// gal te gsungs na sangs rgyas kyang*// brdzun gsung bar ni thal 'gyur zer// bdag gi drang don nges don la// sogs pa'i rnam gzhag legs par bshad// de la'ang sde snod mi shes pa'i// skye bo 'ga' zhig bdag la rgol// gang bden khyed kyis gzigs su gsol// khyed kyis bde gshegs snying po'i sgra// kha cig nges pa'i don du bshad// bdag gi drang ba'i don du ni// lung dang rigs pas bsgrubs te bshad// khyed kyis chos rnams dbu mar gsungs// yod dang med sogs mthar 'dzin bkag

/khyed kyis gsung bzhin bdag gis kyang*// 'chad pa'i tshe yang yod med bkag /gnas lugs bsgom na'ang yod med grol// bsngo ba'i tshe na'ang yod med 'das// yod 'dzin la ni mtshan ma yi// dug can yin zhes khyed kyis gsungs// des na bdag gis bshad pa dang*// bsgom pa dang ni bsngo ba yang*// yod med la sogs dmigs pa'i dug /spangs pa'i cho ga dug med bgyis// de la mu stegs grangs can dang*// nyan thos thams cad yod smra'i lugs// 'dod pa de dag bdag la rgol// 'di dag kyang ni bden mi bden// khyod kyis rnam par phye ste gsungs// sa dang lam gyi rnam gzhag la// 'ga' zhig sa lam mi dgos zer// la la gsang sngags phar phyin gnyis// mthun pa dang ni mi mthun pa'i// rnam dbye phal cher 'khrul pa mthong*// ma 'khrul pa yi rnam gzhag la// mdo rgyud rnams las 'byung ba bzhin// cha mthun khyad par 'phags pa yi// phyi nang sa lam bdag gis bshad// ur+yan dzā lan dha ra dang*// gangs can tsa ri tra la sogs// phyi dang nang gi gnas chen rnams// sa bcu la sogs yin pa la// rgyud sde legs par ma bslabs pa'i// blun po rnams kyis der ma go /des na sa lam mi bgrod par// yul chen tshol ba'i gang zag mang*// de dag khyed kyi gsung rab dang*// 'gal bar mthong nas bdag gis bkag /de la'ang de 'dra'i lugs can rnams// bdag la rgyab kyis phyogs par snang*// de bzhin sangs rgyas sa lam yang*// nyan thos phar phyin gsang sngags la// 'ga' zhig mthun zhing 'ga' zhig la// mi 'dra'i rnam gzhag zab mo yod// blun po rnams kyis 'di mi shes// bdag gis khyed kyi gsung bzhin bshad// de la'ang chags sdang can rnams khro// 'di dag su dang su bden pa// sangs rgyas spyan gyis gzigs su gsol// tshig gi sbyor ba 'chad pa la// 'bru mang po dang de'i skyes bu// ba gnyis pa dang zlas dbye ba// gzhi mthun la sogs tshig sbyor ni// bdag gis sgra dang mthun par bshad// legs par sbyar la bod skad du// mkhas pas sbyar ba thams cad dag

/sgra mi shes pas bsgyur ba la// tshig don nor pa ci rigs mthong*// de 'dra bdag gis bcos nas bshad// ska cog sogs kyis bsgyur ba la// 'ga' zhig sgra dang cung mi mthun// 'ga' zhig don 'gyur dag tu byas// 'ga' zhig brda rnying go ba dka'// 'ga' zhig snga ma btsan par byas// la la gsar bcad dag gis bcos// la la rgya skad sor bzhag snang*// la la khams kyi bye brag gis// rgya skad gcig la'ang bshad tshul gyis// bod kyi sgra 'gyur tha dad snang*// 'di 'dra'i tshig don 'dra mi 'dra// de dag legs par dpyis phyin pa// blun po rnams kyis lta ci mos// mkhas pa yis kyang shes par dka'// de dag bdag gi tha snyad la// sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis legs par shes// 'on kyang skye bo chags sdang dang*// blun phyir bdag gi khyad du gsod// 'di 'dra bdag gis shes ma shes// mgon po sras dang bcas pas mkhyen// 'gro ba dam chos sun 'byin pa// de la 'jig rten phal cher bstod// bdag gis chos min sun phyung bas// 'jig rten phal cher bdag la smod// sangs rgyas 'jig rten thugs brtse la// 'jig rten phal cher rjes mi 'jug /slu byed me tog mda' can gyi// rjes su 'jig rten 'di dag 'brang*// kye ma bsod nams dman pa'i mi// lha skal chad pas 'byung po sgrub// de ltar don dang tshig dag gis// 'khrul dang ma 'khrul dpyad pa la// lung dang rigs pa mi 'gal bar// bdag gi dgag sgrub bgyis pa las// 'jig rten phal cher chags sdang gi /bsams pas bdag la smod mod kyi// thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan mnga' ba// khyed ni bdag la dgyes par bsams// 'phags pa klu sgrub 'di skad du// chos 'di de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis// rtsod pa'i don du ma gsungs mod// 'on kyang 'dis ni gzhan lta rnams// me yis bud shing bzhin du bsregs// zhes gsungs pa dang thog tu bab// bdag kyang gzhan la khyad gsod pa'i// bsams pas bshad pa ma lags mod// 'on kyang khyed kyi sde snod bzhin// bshad pas gzhan gyi chos lugs bsregs// thig skud drang por bzhag pa na// ya yo can rnams sems la gzan// de bzhin khyed kyi gsung bsgrubs pas// chos ltar bcos rnams mnyes ma gyur// bdag la chags sdang ma mchis mod// 'on kyang bstan pa bsrung 'dod pas// bden par smras na pha rol khro// brdzun par smras na sdig pa lci// da ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la// thal sbyar nas ni don 'di zhu// bdag gis bden par smra lags sam// 'on te brdzun par smra bar bgyi// gal te bden par smras na ni/

brdzun par smra ba thams cad khro// de ste brdzun par smras na ni// khyed kyi gsung dang 'gal du dogs// gzhan yang bstan pa bsrung na ni// chos log thams cad sun 'byung 'tshal// 'on te 'jig rten sems bsrung na// chos log la yang bstod 'tshal lo// bden par smras na gzhan sems bsregs// brdzun par smras na bstan pa 'jig /smra ba spangs na don mi rtogs// des na dam pa'i spyod pa dka'// e ḍa zhes bya'i drang srong mchog /de yis gsod pa'i mchod sbyin bkag /de tshe sha la dga' ba yi// gnod sbyin rnams kyis bsad ces grags// deng sang na yang yul de la// e ḍa gtugs pa'i sa zhes zer// dam chos smra ba'i dge slong mchog /me tog zla mdzes thugs rje can// dam chos bshad pa'i le lan gyis// rgyal pos chad pas bcang ces thos// gzhan yang bden par smras pa'i rgyus// smra ba po la 'jig rten kun// log par 'jug pa mang lags pas// thugs rje mnga' bas bskyang du gsol// da ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*// sangs rgyas sras bcas dgongs par zhu// thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs// sems can rgud pa rnams la gzigs// bdud kyi las rnams bzlog tu gsol// rnam pa kun tu byin gyis rlobs// thun mong ba dang phul byung chos// rang gzhan don kun brnyes nas ni// sems can thams cad skyob mdzad pa// ston mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dpal// dge bsnyen mchog gi skur bstan nas// bdag gi 'khrul pa'i drwa ba bcad// yun ring dus nas 'di nyid ni// khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ces// mkha' las de lta'i gsungs bsgrags pa// legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// la las sangs rgyas gsung rab por// log lta'i mun pas khebs pa yang*// yang dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen ces// rmongs pa phal cher gus pas bsten// skyon med yon tan dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas gsung bzhin bsgrub pa yi// bla ma dam pa rnyed na yang*// 'jig rten 'di dag dad pa nyung*// sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bo nyid// so so'i skye bo'i skur bstan pa// bdag gis legs par shes bzhin du// de lta na yang bdag rmongs pas// mthong yang rnam pa thams cad du// ma mthong ba dang 'dra bar gyur// las kyi bag chags shin du sra// khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur ba// de don legs par brda 'phrod pa// de tshe som nyi med par gyur// gsung mchog khyod la spyis phyag 'tshal// sku tshe'i 'du byed gtong ba na// mgon po khyod kyi gsung rab mchog

/nan tan gyis ni bka' stsal pa// 'bad pas ci nus bsgrub pa'i tshe// bar du gcod pa'i chos de grol// des na ji skad gsungs pa yi// bka' stsal de dag ci gsungs bzhin// rnam pa kun du thog tu bab// bden gsung khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// las kyi chu bos bdas pa na// sems la rang dbang thob pa dka'// des na sdig pa'i dbang gyur pa'i// nyes pa bkru ba'i 'jug ngogs mchog /'jig rten mgon pos gzigs su gsol// khyod la thal sbyar gus btud de// rkang gi khong nas 'jigs sems kyis// sdig pa de dag thams cad ni// yang nas yang du bshags par 'tshal// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams kyis// 'gro ba kun gyi sdig pa yi// sa bon drung nas dbyung du gsol// thugs rje mnga' ba'i thugs ldan pa'i// mgon po yud tsam dgongs su gsol// 'gro ba shes rab mig dang bral// yid brtan byams pa'i grogs kyis bslus// nyam nga'i lam du rnam par 'khyam// sdug bsngal khur gyis shin tu non// phyogs kun dgra bos khebs pas na// kha skam mig rtsa zhan gyur pa// sdug pa'i smre sngags sna tshogs 'don// mgon med skyabs kyang ma mchis pa// 'jig rten 'di la gzigs su gsol// khyed kyis dang po 'di skad du// nga ni mgon med khyed cag gi /mgon du gyur zhes gsungs pa gang*// thugs dam brtan pa'i thugs rje can// de la mgon med bdag cag skyabs// las kyi shugs kyis bzlog dka' ba'i// sdug bsngal chu bo shin tu 'jigs// mgon po bdag cag bsgral bar zhu// da dung bdag la zhu ba mchis// brtson 'grus brtan pas gzigs su gsol// ma ga d+dha dang ko sa la// bat+sa la dang yangs pa can// 'phags rgyal dang ni 'khor mo 'jig /ser skya'i grong khyer la sogs pa// yul 'di'i gtsug lag khang dang ni// sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin rnams dang*// khyod kyi sangs rgyas bstan pa dang*// sems can rnams kyi bde sdug la// re zhig gzigs par mdzad du gsol// ur+yan dzā lan dha ra dang*// koṅka na dang sin dhu'i yul// kha che dang ni kha sha sogs// ma kha dang ni li yi yul// de bzhin hor dang hor chen po// ha la shan dang nye ba'i ljongs// rgya nag rgya nag chen po dang*// gan+dha ra dang 'dod pa'i gzugs// zangs gling dang ni gser gyi gling*// zla ba'i gling dang seng ge'i gling*// bhaṅga ba raṇ+ḍa la sogs// lho dang nub na gnas pa'i ljongs// sngon ni khyod kyi bstan pa'i gzhi// kha ba can gyi byang phyogs yul// thub pas bod dang bod chen zhes// yongs su bsgrags pa'i sa phyogs 'dir// nga ni mya ngan 'das gyur nas// lo ni nyis stong lnga brgya na// dam chos rgyas par 'gyur ces gsung*// der ni dam chos 'dzin pa dang*// klog dang kha ton byed pa dang*// nyan dang 'chad dang sgrub pa la// nga yis spyan gyis gzigs so zhes// 'gro mgon khyod kyis lung bstan mdzad// de lta mod kyi da lta yi// skye bo 'di dag bsod nams zhan// dus kyang shin tu snyigs mar gyur// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis// khyod kyi bstan pa chud kyang gsan// de yi stobs kyis sems can rnams// shin tu brnag dka'i sdug bsngal myong*// rngon pas bdas pa'i ri dwags ltar// skrag pas mig rtsa rig rig po// 'jigs pa'i dbang gis gom pa 'khyor// bkres pas lto bar rab tu rnyong*// rlung dang grang bas gdungs pa'i lus// 'ga' zhig nad kyis rnam par bcom// la la'i nye du 'brel bas brlag

/'ga' yi lam yang rnam par bkag /'ga' zhig shes pa 'thoms nas snang*// bsod zad rnams la gdon yang sdang*// sngon chad nyes par spyad pa yi// las ngan smin pa bdag cag la// sangs rgyas sras bcas gzigs su gsol// mi yi 'jig rten mtho ris zhes// khyod kyis bde 'gro'i bsngags pa mdzad// 'on kyang mtho ris sdug bsngal 'di// mgon po myur du skyabs 'tshal lo// gang la skyabs su mchis kyang ni// skyabs de dag gis bslu bar mthong*// bslu ba med pa skyabs kyi mchog /skyabs mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi// sems can dmyal ba'i gnas la yang*// thugs rje ldan pas yud tsam gzigs// yang sos dang ni thig nag dang*// bsdus 'joms dang ni ngu 'bod sogs// mnar med srid pa bzod dka'i bar// mes bsregs mtshon cha'i char phab pas// nyam chung mkhun sgra 'byin pa tsam// sdug skad 'byin par mi nus pa// tsha ba'i sems dmyal rnams la gzigs// chu bur can sogs 'khyags pa yis// lus gas 'gul nyams ma mchis pa// 'di 'dra'i sems dmyal ji ltar gso// mgon po yi dwags bkres skom gyis// gdungs pas yun ring nyam thag pa// bza' btung 'dod pa'i cho nge can// 'di la ji ltar bgyi ba gsungs// brtse ldan thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// dud 'gro'i gnas kyang gzigs su gsol// phan tshun za bas rnam par 'jigs// 'ga' zhig bsregs te gsod pa mthong*// 'ga' zhig bzung nas rgyu lto 'byin// 'di la mgon pos thugs rje mdzod// lha min lha yi gnas na yang*// mtho ris sdug bsngal bsam las 'das// thog mar skyid pa bskyed bskyed nas// tha mar sdug bsngal gyis bcom ste// smre sngags 'don zhing ngan 'gror mchi// brtse ldan kun nas gzigs su gsol// sems can las la spyod pa la// khyod kyi thugs rje mi 'jug na// 'gro ba bde bar gnas pa la// khyed kyi thugs rje 'jug lags sam// sman pas nad pa gso ba dang*// mgron po dag la skyel ma dang*// long ba dag la dmigs bu dang*// phongs pa dag la sbyin bdag dang*// gsod par nges la'ang skyob pa mthong*// blun zhing snying rje shas chung ba// nus pa med pa'i skye bo yang*// 'gro la phan phyir 'di 'dra yi// phan par brtson par bgyid lags na// khyod ni zhi ba thams cad mkhyen// brtse bas sems can kun phan bzhed// nus pa dpag tu med mchis pa// des na phan 'dogs mdzad par rigs// 'gro ba las kyi rnam smin la// spyod phyir phan par mi nus na// dang po las la 'jug pa nyid// mgon po khyod kyis cis mi 'gegs// de yang dgag par mi spyod na// nga ni thams cad mkhyen pa zhes// 'khor gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra// bsgrags pa'i dgos pa ji ltar lags// 'di 'dra'i skabs su mu stegs dang*// bdud kyi phyogs rnams rgol na ni// de la chos dang mthun pa'i lan// bdag gis ji ltar gdab par bgyi// khyod ni byams dang snying rje sogs// tshad med bzhi yi thugs dang ldan// lha yi mig dang rdzu 'phrul sogs// mngon shes drug po thogs mi mnga'// de slad byams sogs kyis bskyangs te// rdzu 'phrul gyis ni cis mi 'dul// gdug pa can la rgyas sras kyis// rdzu 'phrul gyis ni ma bsdigs na// nyes pa yin zhes khyed nyid gsungs// cho 'phrul gsum la mnga' 'byor pa// khyod la nyes pa 'di mnga' na// rgyal sras rnams la'ang mi mtshungs sam// gal te 'ga' zhig de skad 'dri// de la bdag gis ji skad gleng*// stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa khyod// bdud kyi stobs kyang 'joms mdzad na// stobs chung rnams kyis gzhan 'tshe ba'i// stobs 'di khyod kyis cis mi 'joms// dbang bcu dag la dbang mdzad pa'i// mgon pos 'gro kun skyob mdzad na// 'gro ba dbang med 'di dag la// khyod kyi dbang 'byor ji ltar lags// med pa yongs su sprul pa dang*// yod pa gzhan du sgyur pa sogs// yongs su dag pa bzhi ldan pa// khyed kyi 'phrin las dus la bab// nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin gyis// 'gro ba'i phongs pa sel mdzad pa// 'di ltar phongs pa gzigs nas ni// ting 'dzin de la 'jug tu gsol// khyod kyi thugs rje chen po ni// 'jig rten kun la lan drug gzigs// bsnyel ba mi mnga' chos nyid kyang*// 'gro ba'i don la rtag tu dgongs// khyod ni nyon mongs mi mnga' ba// rang dang gzhan gyi nyon mongs 'joms// da lta'i 'gro ba nyon mongs pa// 'joms phyir khyod la gsol ba 'debs// dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin sogs// rnam pa kun du brnyes khyod kyi// 'phrin las 'bad pa ci zhig 'tshal// de slad bdag cag rjes su zung*// 'jigs pa med pa'i chos bzhi brnyes// mu stegs gzhan gyis mi rdzi ba'i// 'khor du seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa// 'jig rten kun la gsal bar mdzod// sangs rgyas kho na'i ma 'dres chos// drug phrag gnyis dang gsum gnyis ldan// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// bla ma khyod la bdag gsol 'debs// thabs mchog dag gis legs bsgrubs pa// chos nyid gzigs pa'i ye shes can// khyod kyi 'phrin las mngon bsams na// bsam mi khyab pa 'di ltar snang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du// sangs rgyas rnams la chos skur snang*// stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su// rgyal sras mchog la longs skur ston// 'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas par// 'gro la sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed// skye ba'i sprul pa dga' ldan du// lha rnams gdul bar bya phyir bzhugs// bzo yi sprul pas dri za yi// rgyal po rab dga' rnam par btul// mchog gi sprul pa sna tshogs pas// gdul dka' 'ga' zhig gdul pa'i phyir// rnam pa sna tshogs ngo mtshar rmad// 'jig rten skyong rnams 'dul ba'i phyir// ri rab ri yi rtse mo ru// sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po der// dbang bskur mdzad nas rnam par btul// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'dul ba'i phyir// rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs kyis bskor// mi yi 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir// gzhon nu'i rol rtsed sna tshogs mdzad// dka' thub dka' ba sun dbyung phyir// khyed kyis lo drug dka' ba spyad// rgyal po zas gtsang sngon rabs kyis// mgu mdzad khams drug bshigs nas btul// rgyal po chen po bi lin+da// 'khor los sgyur ba'i gzugs kyis btul// rgyal po u tra ya na ni// khyod sku ri mor bris pas btul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi cho 'phrul gyis// lha dang bcas pa'i bdud kyi sde// btul nas chos kyis grol bar mdzad// rgyal po ma skyes dgra yi sdig

/ras yug chen po'i gdams pas sbyangs// dge slong dgra bcom 'gro ba dang*// dmyal bar bskyur nas phyi nas gso// phyag na rdo rje stobs chen gyis// dbang phyug chen po bsad nas btul// bdud kyi dpung rnams bsdigs nas btul// lha mo nam gru bstod pas btul// spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje dang*// rig sngags sbyor ba'i cho ga dang*// ri lu sman gyi sbyor ba yis// sdug bsngal can rnams legs par gsos// de bzhin rgyal sras thugs rje can// cho 'phrul gsum gyis 'dul mdzad pa// de dag kun gyis 'jig rten 'di// bu gcig bzhin du bskyangs zhes grags// mnyan yod la sogs gdul dka' ba// gdul phyir shā ri'i bu la sogs// nyan thos chen po mngags pa mdzad// rigs dad bya phyir 'char ka dang*// yul can rgyal po gdul ba'i phyir// 'phags pa kā t+ya ya na sogs// gang la gang gis 'dul gyur pa// de 'dra'i tshul gyis thams cad btul// de lta'i 'phrin las bsam yas pa// mthong ngam thos par gyur na yang*// su zhig ngo mtshar skye mi 'gyur// sngon gyi 'phrin las de 'dra'i cha// da lta'i 'gro ba nyam thag cing*// mgon med 'dren pa ma mchis pa// glen zhing phyogs kyang mi 'tshal ba// ri dwags rgya ru chud 'dra ba'i// sems can rnams la mi gzigs na// thugs rje mnga' ba'i thugs rje de// ji ltar lags par gsung du gsol// khyab 'jug 'jig rten phan 'dod pas// dga' byed dga' byed dgra sta can// mi yi seng ge mi thung sogs// rnam par 'phrul pa du ma yis// chos min byed pa'i gdug pa can// 'bad pa chen pos btul zhes grags// des ni 'phags pa'i chos ma thob// byang chub sems kyang ma bskyed mod// 'on kyang phan pa'i spyod pa 'di// mgon po chen po gzigs su gsol// brgya byin gtsug na zla ba dang*// dbyig gi snying po byin za'i bdag /nor lha klu rgyal ma dros pa// nor rgyas rgya mtsho'i rgyal po sogs// de dag 'phags pa'i chos ma thob// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje med// de lta mod kyi rang rang gi

/nus pa bzhin du gzhan la phan// nyi zla gza' skar ma bcol yang*// mkha' la rgyu zhing sa steng skyong*// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// sems med kyang ni re ba bskong*// mgon khyod byang chub spyod pa'i tshe// lha yi dbang por 'khrungs pa na// 'jig rten chang la dga' ba dag /'bad pa chen pos zlog par mdzad// tshangs pa'i rgyal por khyod 'khrungs tshe// log ltas zin pa'i rgyal po la// ngo mtshar can gyi skur bstan nas// de yi log lta bzlog ces gsungs// byang chub chen por gyur pa na// 'bad pas rdzu 'phrul bsgrubs nas kyang*// mi dge'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa'i// rgyal po 'khor bcas chos kyis btul// de la sogs pa skyes pa'i rabs// rnam pa sna tshogs rmad byung mdzad// 'gro ba gzhan gyi srog skyob phyir// nyid kyi sku yang btang ba mtshar// mgon po khyod kyis rgyu yi dus// 'jig rten chos las ma brgal yang*// byang chub spyod pa'i gnas skabs ni// bdag cag phan pa du mas bskyangs// da ni 'bras bu mchog brnyes nas// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs bzhin du// sdug bsngal can la mi gzigs pa// khyod kyi thugs rje chen po gang*// nyam thag 'jigs pas bdas pas na// khyed la skyabs su mchi zhing 'bros// 'bros pa de bar thugs rje yi// spyan ras gzigs kyang ci zhig skyon// sems can las la spyod pa la// khyod kyis phan par mi sbyor kyang*// 'on kyang sdug bsngal can de la// bka' tsam stsal na cir 'gyur lags// 'jig rten pa dag ma phan yang*// sdug bsngal ldan pa'i sdug grogs bgyid// khyod kyis de yi cha tsam zhig /mdzad na'ang dbugs 'byin bgyid pa gsung*// de lta na yang kun mkhyen khyed// bdag cag 'gro la mi gzigs na// da ni skyob par byed pa yi// kye ma skyabs gzhan gang la bgyi// ji ltar sprul pa'i rgyal po 'ga'// thar bar bya phyir sprul pa brtson// sgyu ma'i mkhan po sgyu ma yi// dpung gis 'jigs pa kun las sgrol// mgon po khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'jigs pa kun las bsgral du gsol// mgon khyod kun la phan mdzad kyang*// bdud dang mu stegs dgra bzhin lta// lhas byin legs pa'i skar ma sogs// slob mar gyur kyang rgyab kyis phyogs// sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa// kun mkhyen gyis kyang mi mgu na// bdag 'dra ngan pas sems can don// bsgrub par 'dod pa bzhad gad gnas// na ba'i bu la khyad par du// ma ni gdung ba skye ba ltar// de bzhin rgyal ba sras bcas kyang*/

dam pa min la khyad par brtse// de skad gsungs pa'i tshig khums pas// blun po bdag ni spobs pa skyes// bzhad gad mkhan gyis rgyal po la// ji ltar glengs kyang mi khro ba'i// khrims 'di chos rgyal snga ma yis// 'jig rten bde ba'i don du bcas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi zlos gar la// khro rgyal thugs rje ldan pa yis// gnad du bskul nas sangs rgyas kun// nye bar byin gyis rlob ces gsung*// de ltar khums nas thugs rje can// mgon po khyod la yang dang yang*// mi shes bzhin du zhu ba'i 'phrin// bdag ni spyi brtol skyes par gyur// de ltar zhu ba'i 'phrin yig 'di// gsan nas 'di yi 'phrin lan zhig /'gro la dngos su mi gsung yang*// 'phrin gyis gdams par mdzad du gsol// mgon po khyod kyi yon tan 'tshal// bka' drin yang ni dran zhing mchis// de slad zhing gi rdul snyed kyi// lus btud pas ni spyis phyag 'tshal// phyi dang gsang ba nyid don can// lus dang bla na med pa yi// mchod pa'i sprin ni mtha' yas pas// yon tan rgya mtshor mchod par bgyi// las kyi rlung gi bdas pas na// sdig pa'i rgya mtshor bdag cag ltung*// de slad nyes par spyad pa rnams// rnam pa kun du bshags par 'tshal// 'jig rten rgyal ba'i slob ma dang*// rang rgyal dang ni rgyal ba'i sras// rgyal ba rnams kyis mdzad pa yi// bsod nams kun la yi rang ngo*// 'jig rten blun por gzigs nas ni// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mi mdzad// bdag cag lhar bcas 'jig rten rnams// chos gsung phyir na bskul bar gsol// sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed dka' bar// bstan phyir mya ngan 'da' bzhed pa// de la 'jig rten gnas kyi bar// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs su gsol// bslu ba mi mnga' skyabs kyi mchog /srid pa'i 'jigs pa skyob pa gsum// de la byang chub snying po'i bar// rnam pa kun tu bdag skyabs mchi// 'gro kun bde la 'god slad du// sangs rgyas spyan sngar bdag mchis te// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// spyod pa rgya mtshor spyad par bgyi// dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan// yod med 'dzin pa'i dug spangs te// 'jam dpal ji ltar dgyes pa yis// bsngo ba de bzhin bdag bsngo'o// da dung bdag la bsngo ba'i tshul// sngon chad gzhan gyis ma bsams pa'i// 'gro ba'i phongs pa bskyab pa'i phyir// skyob pa mchog la bdag 'di zhu// gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la// sangs rgyas dus las mi 'da' zhes// khyod kyi zhal gyis bzhes pa mtshar// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// gang dag khyed kyi gdul bya min// de yi drung du bdag song ste// rnam 'phrul bye bas yid bsgyur nas// khyod kyi bstan la 'jug par shog
